sentiment_score_definition: x <= -0.35: Bearish; -0.35 < x <= -0.15: Somewhat-Bearish; -0.15 < x < 0.15: Neutral; 0.15 <= x < 0.35: Somewhat_Bullish; x >= 0.35: Bullish
relevance_score_definition: 0 < x <= 1, with a higher score indicating higher relevance.

feed.title: Cable One (NYSE:CABO) Posts Q2 CY2026 Sales In Line With Estimates
feed.summary: Cable One (NYSE:CABO) reported Q2 CY2026 sales of $348.9 million, meeting Wall Street expectations, but revenue was down 8.4% year-on-year. The company posted a significant GAAP loss of $204.35 per share due to non-cash asset impairment charges. Despite revenue meeting estimates, declining subscriber numbers and negative operating margins indicate ongoing struggles for the internet, cable TV, and phone provider.

feed.title: Cheesecake Factory (CAKE) director-linked entity reports 64-share stock sale

Following the sale, Maricopa Capital LLC holds 3,853 indirect shares, and an additional 178 shares are held in custodial accounts for his children. This transaction was not conducted under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan.

feed.title: Carter Bankshares, Inc. Q2 2026: Revenue $61.5M, Net income $28.9M, EPS $1.31— 10-Q Summary
feed.summary: Carter Bankshares, Inc. reported strong financial results for Q2 2026, with revenue of $61.5M, net income of $28.9M, and diluted EPS of $1.31, all showing significant year-over-year increases. These improvements were driven by higher net interest income, margin expansion, and strategic portfolio actions. The company also expanded its market presence and enhanced its credit profile and liquidity through operational moves.

feed.summary: Broadwind (BWEN) is scheduled to announce its quarterly earnings before the market opens on August 11. feed.title: Copart CEO Jeffrey Liaw Sells 27,745 Shares for $846,000
feed.summary: Copart CEO Jeffrey Liaw sold 27,745 shares of the company's common stock for approximately $846,000 on July 28, 2026, as part of a pre-scheduled Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. This sale reduced his direct holdings by 22% but he retains significant equity exposure through remaining shares and derivative securities. The transaction is not seen as concerning for investors, as it was pre-planned and Liaw maintains substantial ownership, with the stock's recent decline attributed to slowing revenue growth rather than core profitability issues.

feed.title: CoStar Says U.S. Office Inventory Shrunk by 7M Square Feet
feed.summary: CoStar Group forecasts that U.S. office vacancy will stabilize through 2026 before gradually declining, attributing this to a significant supply contraction, with office inventory shrinking by seven million square feet over the past year. This reduction is primarily due to historically low new deliveries and an increase in demolitions. Despite a downgrade in net absorption forecasts for 2026 and 2027, the ongoing supply contraction is expected to drive down the national office vacancy rate, albeit slowly, while acknowledging potential risks from productivity gains through AI.

feed.title: Microchip Technology Incorporated (NASDAQ:MCHP) Plans $0.46 Quarterly Dividend
feed.summary: Microchip Technology (NASDAQ:MCHP) has declared a quarterly dividend of $0.455 per share, maintaining its 23-year streak of annual dividend increases. The dividend, payable on September 9th to shareholders of record on August 24th, represents an annualized yield of approximately 2.4%. The semiconductor company also recently reported strong quarterly earnings, beating analyst estimates with $0.76 EPS and $1.48 billion in revenue.

feed.title: Snap-On Incorporated (NYSE:SNA) Plans $2.44 Quarterly Dividend
feed.summary: Snap-On Incorporated (NYSE:SNA) has announced a quarterly dividend of $2.44 per share, payable on September 10 to shareholders of record by August 19. This dividend equates to $9.76 annually, offering a 2.4% yield, and marks the 15th consecutive year the company has increased its dividend. The company's recent quarterly results slightly surpassed expectations, with EPS of $4.96 and revenue of $1.24 billion, and the dividend is well-supported by a payout ratio below 50%.

feed.title: Electronic Arts closes at $209.70 following $55 billion buyout, attention moves to debt
feed.summary: Electronic Arts (EA) completed its $55 billion acquisition, with trading in its shares ending on August 4. Former shareholders received $210 in cash per share, while the stock closed at $209.70, just 30 cents shy of the payout. The company's significant debt, including $20 billion pledged for the acquisition, now becomes a primary focus for investors, representing a substantial leverage against its operating cash flow.

feed.title: Vessel upgrade on the agenda: SLB, Equinor strike multi-year deal to unlock Norway's tight offshore reservoirs
feed.summary: SLB and Equinor have signed a multi-year agreement for advanced reservoir stimulation services on the Norwegian Continental Shelf. This deal includes a major upgrade to the MV Island Captain well stimulation vessel, enhancing its capacity for tight offshore reservoirs. The upgraded vessel will be able to carry up to 2 million pounds of proppant, supporting the development of next-generation tight-reservoir projects in Norway.

feed.title: Gen Digital Inc. Declares Quarterly Dividend of $0.12 (NASDAQ:GEN)
feed.summary: Gen Digital Inc. (NASDAQ:GEN) declared a quarterly dividend of $0.125 per share, payable on September 9th to shareholders of record on August 17th. This dividend represents a 1.8% yield and is well-covered by the company's earnings, with a payout ratio of 17.9%. The company recently reported strong quarterly earnings of $0.71 per share, surpassing estimates, and revenue increased by 6.3% year-over-year to $1.34 billion.

feed.title: Delta Air Lines Is Launching Its First Direct Route to Saudi Arabia
feed.summary: Delta Air Lines is set to launch its first direct route to Saudi Arabia, with nonstop service between Atlanta (ATL) and Riyadh (RUH) beginning October 23, 2026. This new route will operate daily initially, then transition to three times weekly, using Delta’s Airbus A350-900 aircraft. The expansion follows a 2024 partnership agreement with Riyadh Air, connecting over 150 North American markets to Riyadh.

feed.title: CELZ Stock Surges As New Diabetes Patent Fuels Momentum
feed.summary: Creative Medical Technology Holdings Inc. (CELZ) stock surged over 22% after receiving a USPTO Notice of Allowance for a new patent covering exosome-based immunotherapy for Type 1 diabetes, strengthening its MyeloCelz platform. While this patent boosts the company's intellectual property and potential for future partnerships, it does not include new clinical data or regulatory approvals. The company's financials show minimal revenue and significant losses, indicating it remains an early-stage, high-risk clinical story driven by speculative trading momentum.

feed.title: Rosenblatt Securities Reiterates Buy Rating for Microchip Technology (NASDAQ:MCHP)
feed.summary: Rosenblatt Securities has reiterated its "Buy" rating for Microchip Technology (NASDAQ:MCHP), setting a $120 price target, which suggests a significant upside of 61.38%. This comes after Microchip Technology surpassed quarterly expectations with $0.76 adjusted EPS and $1.48 billion in revenue, coupled with an optimistic fiscal second-quarter EPS guidance. Despite a positive analyst consensus, concerns remain regarding the stock's elevated valuation and recent insider selling.

feed.title: Why KLA (KLAC) Is Up 7.1% After Dividend Hike And Strong 2026 Outlook Update
feed.summary: KLA Corporation (KLAC) stock rose 7.1% following a dividend hike and a strong outlook update for 2026. The company declared a quarterly cash dividend of US$0.23 per share and provided guidance for the September 2026 quarter, projecting US$4.0 billion in revenue and US$1.14 GAAP diluted EPS. This positive news reinforces KLA's investment narrative, particularly concerning its essential role in semiconductor process control, while analysts continue to assess potential risks like export tariffs and customer concentration.

feed.title: RBC Adjusts PT on Akamai Technologies to $135 From $150, Maintains Sector Perform Rating
feed.summary: RBC has adjusted its price target for Akamai Technologies (AKAM) to $135, down from $150, while maintaining a Sector Perform rating. This update reflects a revised valuation for the company. Akamai Technologies is a leading provider of Internet applications and content distribution services, focusing on content distribution, application development, and data management.

feed.title: Dream Finders’ $2.2B Beazer Deal Puts Mortgage Capture In Focus
feed.summary: Dream Finders Homes is acquiring Beazer Homes USA in a $2.2 billion all-cash deal, aiming to become the sixth-largest publicly traded U.S. homebuilder. A key driver for this acquisition is the expected increase in mortgage and title capture rates, as Dream Finders operates an integrated financial services platform, unlike Beazer. This transaction highlights a growing trend of homebuilders leveraging in-house financial services to boost profitability and streamline the homebuying process.

feed.title: Deutsche Bank Adjusts Keurig Dr Pepper Price Target to $32 From $30, Maintains Hold Rating
feed.summary: Deutsche Bank has increased its price target for Keurig Dr Pepper Inc. (KDP) shares to $32 from the previous $30, while reiterating a "Hold" rating on the stock. This adjustment comes amidst other financial news for Keurig Dr Pepper, including its Q2 2026 earnings report showing adjusted earnings and net sales increases. The company also reaffirmed its 2026 net sales forecast, projecting between $25.9 billion and $26.4 billion.

feed.title: Super Micro Q4 Earnings Preview: What To Expect From Upcoming Report
feed.summary: Super Micro Computer (NASDAQ:SMCI) is set to release its fiscal fourth-quarter results on August 11, with analysts expecting significant growth in both earnings and revenue. The company has updated its outlook, indicating a backlog exceeding $60 billion and improved gross margin projections. Despite this positive outlook, Wall Street remains cautious, focusing on execution, cash flow, and competitive pressures in the AI server market.

feed.title: BTGO FINAL DEADLINE ALERT: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP Reminds BitGo Holdings (BTGO) Investors of Securities Class Action Lawsuit Deadline on August 7, 2026
feed.summary: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP is investigating potential securities fraud claims against BitGo Holdings, Inc. (BTGO) and reminds investors of the August 7, 2026, deadline to seek lead plaintiff status in a federal securities class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that BitGo and its executives made false and misleading statements regarding the impact of declining digital asset prices on the company's financial performance, leading to significant investor losses following its IPO and subsequent financial disclosures. Investors who purchased BitGo securities during the specified Class Period are encouraged to contact the law firm to discuss their legal rights.

feed.title: Xcel Energy Foundation Turns 25 With $160M Invested In Local Nonprofits Since 2001
feed.summary: The Xcel Energy Foundation is celebrating 25 years of community giving, having invested over $160 million in various organizations since 2001. This includes $82 million in grants to local non-profits and $73.6 million from employee contributions. Last year alone, the foundation supported 151 Minnesota non-profits with $5.4 million, alongside significant employee volunteer hours and environmental initiatives.

feed.title: PPL Corp misses second-quarter profit estimates as costs weigh

feed.summary: Autozi Internet Technology (Global) Ltd. (Nasdaq: AZI) has announced a letter of intent for a proposed reverse takeover transaction with a privately held operating company. This transaction is expected to transform Autozi into a significantly larger Nasdaq-listed platform with an estimated combined valuation of approximately $320 million. Autozi shareholders will continue to hold equity interests in the combined company and benefit from future growth opportunities.

feed.title: AIG’s General Insurance Q2 Underwriting Income Up 10%
feed.summary: American International Group's (AIG) General Insurance segment reported a nearly 10% increase in Q2 2026 underwriting income, reaching $686 million, despite higher catastrophe losses including $75 million related to the Middle East conflict. CEO Eric Anderson noted the company's strong performance in a transitioning market, highlighting the importance of underwriting expertise and portfolio diversity. Overall net income attributable to AIG shareholders decreased due to investments in Corebridge and equity security, though AIG gained $710 million from selling its remaining Corebridge interest.

feed.title: The 2026 Hyundai Venue Is a Big Deal at a Bargain Price: Review
feed.summary: The 2026 Hyundai Venue offers a compelling new-car value proposition, providing a feature-rich, comfortable, and well-built vehicle at a bargain price, significantly below the average cost of a new car. With its low starting price of $22,200 and a top trim at $24,475, it stands out in a market where inexpensive new cars are rare. The review highlights its livability, ample features for the price, and surprising interior quality, positioning it as a strong alternative to more expensive new cars and even many used vehicles.

feed.title: Dream Finders Homes to Acquire Beazer Homes in $2.2 Billion Deal
feed.summary: Dream Finders Homes is set to acquire Beazer Homes in an all-cash transaction valued at $2.2 billion, aiming to become the sixth-largest U.S. homebuilder. This acquisition will expand Dream Finders' national operating platform to 26 markets and approximately 520 active communities, enhancing its product mix and generating over $100 million in annual run-rate cost synergies. The deal, unanimously approved by both boards, is expected to close in Q4 2026 and be double-digit accretive to earnings per share in the first year.

feed.title: Dream Finders to Buy Beazer for $915 Million
feed.summary: Dream Finders Homes has agreed to acquire Beazer Homes in an all-cash deal valued at approximately $915 million, following months of negotiations. Dream Finders will pay $33.50 per share for Beazer's common stock, a transaction that values Beazer at about $2.2 billion including debt.

feed.title: Why Emerson Electric (EMR) Is Up 5.6% After Raising Guidance And Expanding Its Industrial AI Push
feed.summary: Emerson Electric (EMR) reported strong third-quarter fiscal 2026 results, including higher sales and net income, and raised its full-year guidance. The company also announced a significant expansion into industrial AI, appointing a new Chief Technology and AI Officer and launching new AI-enabled platforms. This strategic shift aims to move Emerson towards higher-value industrial software and AI solutions, supporting its long-term investment narrative despite risks associated with cyclical markets and competition.

feed.title: The Bull Case For Aramark (ARMK) Could Change Following Dividend Payout And New UCCS Deal
feed.summary: Aramark recently approved a quarterly dividend of US$0.12 per share and announced a long-term partnership with the University of Colorado Colorado Springs (UCCS) for campus hospitality services. These developments reinforce Aramark's strategy of combining capital returns with expansion in the education sector. While the UCCS deal supports Aramark's core growth drivers in higher education, the company's investment narrative remains sensitive to cost control in a tight labor market and potential pressure on contract economics in cyclical client sectors.

feed.title: Sensors, Space Cameras and Power Systems Meet at Teledyne Booth 711
feed.summary: Teledyne will showcase its integrated defense, space, and advanced technology solutions at the 2026 Space & Missile Defense Symposium in Huntsville, Alabama. The company will highlight its capabilities in sensing, imaging, microelectronics, advanced packaging, and power systems, crucial for national security, space exploration, and missile defense missions. Visitors to Booth 711 can explore solutions including visible and infrared sensors, radiation-hardened semiconductors, and various power systems.

feed.title: AMETEK Sets Sept. 30 Payment Date for Its $0.34 Dividend

This dividend is payable on September 30, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 15, 2026. The company, a global provider of industrial technology solutions with approximately $7.5 billion in annual sales, targets double-digit percentage earnings per share growth and superior return on total capital.

feed.title: Morgan Stanley, Texas Stock Exchange could light up Dallas skyline
feed.summary: The Dallas City Plan Commission has approved signage proposals for the Texas Stock Exchange (TXSE) and Morgan Stanley, moving them closer to adding their brands to the Dallas skyline. The TXSE ticker will overlook Klyde Warren Park, and Morgan Stanley's signage will be at Fountain Place. This development signifies the Dallas region's growing prominence as "Y'all Street" and a major destination for Wall Street investment.

feed.title: Alpha Q2 Loss Reflects Weak Coal Market
feed.summary: Alpha Metallurgical Resources Inc. (NYSE: AMR) reported a net loss in Q2 2026 due to weak global metallurgical coal prices, lower shipment volumes, and operational disruptions, leading to a lowered full-year shipment outlook and increased production cost guidance. Despite the challenges, Alpha maintained a strong balance sheet and continued its stock repurchase program. The company attributes much of the increased cost pressure to temporary operational issues and remains confident in its long-term position, anticipating recovery as steel demand improves.

feed.title: B&G Foods Announces Retirement of CEO Casey Keller, Selection of Successor
feed.summary: B&G Foods has announced the retirement of its President and CEO, Kenneth C. “Casey” Keller, after five years with the company. Keller's retirement is effective August 7, and he will assist with the leadership transition. The Board of Directors has already selected his successor, who currently holds a senior leadership position at another public company, and an announcement is expected soon.

feed.title: Take-Two sticks to annual bookings outlook, says on track for 'GTA VI' November launch
feed.summary: Take-Two Interactive maintained its annual bookings forecast and reiterated the November 19 launch date for "Grand Theft Auto VI." Despite projecting current-quarter bookings below Wall Street estimates due to a lack of new titles, the company expects "GTA VI" to be a major revenue driver, building on the success of its predecessor, "GTA V." Investors are also keenly watching for details on a potential online, multiplayer mode for "GTA VI," which could provide a consistent revenue stream similar to "GTA V Online."
